items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I played a winter down there with the Verrett boys, Arthur and Albert Verrett. They had a seven piece orchestra down there... Arthur played the saxophone and clarinet. I played trumpet.

ctx.x: And you played on those tours. Where did you play? Concerts or streets?

Concerts. Everything that any band could play. We had an engagement for a month engagement on the boardwalk in Atlantic City, New Jersey, right beside Arthur Pryor's band. And this kid band was really one of the most marvelous boys band in the world. I heard them once. They're only 20 years old. Because they had already been over in England with the Cummings Wild West Circus as a featured attraction in the London Hippodrome.
